build_hand_pose_dataset: build a CocoWholeBodyHandDataset instance to load COCO wholebody hand pose annotations for training
load_hand_annotations: load hand pose annotations from a COCO format JSON file into instance and image lists
review_CocoWholeBodyHandDataset: review the CocoWholeBodyHandDataset class and its 21 hand keypoint structure for left and right hands
refactor_load_annotations: refactor the _load_annotations method to support additional hand keypoint formats or filtering criteria
summarize_hand_keypoints: summarize the 21 COCO wholebody hand keypoints including wrist, thumb, forefinger, middle, ring, and pinky joints
